title: Guide to Medical Interpreter Services: September 2026
summary: Medical interpreter services guide for health systems: compare OPI, VRI, in-person, and AI modalities, costs, Section 1557 rules, and EHR integration.
body_markdown:
###


Yes, when the product is built for healthcare and backed by a Business Associate Agreement, encryption in transit and at rest, and clinical quality controls. Opalite Health is designed for HIPAA-compliant use and pairs those safeguards with Opalite Guardian, a real-time layer that flags hallucinations, omissions, medication inconsistencies, and low-confidence outputs during live medical interpreter service delivery.


###


It depends on volume, language mix, and connection times, but most systems now run both. Traditional medical interpreter phone service works for scheduled complex visits, while AI interpretation handles instant access, rare languages, after-hours coverage, and routine care without per-minute charges for silent time.


###


Interpretation covers spoken touchpoints: scheduling calls, intake, the clinical encounter, informed consent discussions, medication counseling, discharge, and follow-up. Written translation covers appointment reminders, intake forms, consent documents, medication labels, after-visit summaries, and portal messages, which is where free phone translation services and Google Translate quietly fill gaps they should not.


###
